facts: Article 8(e): operator publishes theoretical return and six prior monthly actual return percentages; jackpot prizes are excluded from the actual-return percentage calculation.
Article 8(k): operator must disclose the percentage of the player's participation allocated to formation of the jackpot.
Article 14: only progressive jackpots may be offered for online slot-machine games under this basic regulation; guaranteed/operator-funded jackpots are not allowed.
Game-specific rules remain authoritative for exact participation, trigger and prize mechanics.
regulatoryFoundation.researchImplication: Missing contribution on an indexed marketing page is a retrieval problem, not permission to estimate. Search exact rules/in-game help because Spain requires the participation percentage allocated to the jackpot to be available.

crossOperatorEvidence: Botemania pages describe sharing across Botemania, Canal Bingo and MONOPOLY Casino for parts of this family.
MONOPOLY Casino Winstones Bote independently publishes base 94.81%, contribution 0.68%, reset to 0 and the same family linkage.
poolFamilies.keyFinding: Games can feed the same declared shared progressive network with materially different contribution percentages. Contribution rate therefore cannot be substituted for jackpot hazard or win probability.

highValueNationalTargets: Recover exact contribution/trigger rules for every canonical feed meter using Spain's Article 8(k) disclosure requirement as retrieval leverage.
